cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

rubric.reason: Before its first explanation in Turn 2, the mentor called preview_frame at time 1 on Title, which falls inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply says nothing incorrect about the frame.

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1), and Turn 2 ends by handing back the rest by name: "The other three are yours: Title's second Position move (1.5 s to 3 s), its Scale and its Opacity. Ease them and say done."

Every name and time matches the snapshot: 11 pairs is 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased, the six layers are Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take, Subtitle Opacity's hard stop at 1.3 s matches linear_end "end", Title's 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s pairs match, and Old Take and Icon match hidden_layers and precomp_layers.

The case-03 demo turn allows one idea sentence before the demonstration, but Turn 2 opens with two sentences of explanation ("…moves at one speed the whole way, then changes speed abruptly at 1.5 s. That's linear, and it's why the motion looks mechanical."), which is the second sentence of explanation the rule names as a fail.
Before the first demo, the mentor called preview_frame {"time":1,"layer":"Title"}, which falls inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply does not describe the frame wrongly.

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target 1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1, and the turn ends by handing back the rest by name: "The other three are yours: Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, and its Scale and Opacity from 0.5 s to 1.5 s. Say done when you've eased them."

Every name and time matches the snapshots: 11 pairs (10 linear + 1 partly_eased) across 6 layers (Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow, Old Take); Subtitle Opacity is eased at the start and linear at the end (linear_end "end"); Title's four pairs have the right times; Old Take is hidden and Icon is a precomp.

The show-me demo turn has one idea sentence (linear motion moves at one speed and stops hard), then the demo with Edit > Undo, one look-at sentence (hourglasses instead of diamonds, Title slows in and out), and a hand-back naming the three remaining pairs that ends on "Say done", with no lists or second explanation.

Before the first explanation and demo in turn 2, the mentor called preview_frame at time 1 on Title, which is inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply makes no wrong claim about the frame.

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1), and turn 2 ends with "The other three are yours: Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, its Scale and its Opacity. Say \"done\" when you've eased them."

Every name and time is backed by the snapshots: 11 pairs is 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased across 6 finding layers; Subtitle Opacity's linear_end is "end", which matches "stops hard at the end"; Old Take is in hidden_layers and Icon in precomp_layers; and Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity all match the findings.

Turn 1 ends on the single layer question; turn 2, a 'show me' before any explanation, gives one idea sentence ("moves at one speed the whole way… that's linear"), the demo with Edit > Undo, one 'look at those two keyframes' sentence, and a hand-back naming the three remaining pairs that ends on "Say done", with no list or Graph Editor tour.
